Automated machine learning is the fastest-growing market we track right now: about $3.20B in 2025, projected at $83.11B by 2035, a 38.5% CAGR.

Platforms are the largest offering segment, and cloud deployment is scaling fastest because it lets teams without data scientists build and ship models. BFSI, healthcare and retail lead adoption. North America leads; Asia Pacific grows fastest.
